incidents.summary: An overheating chemical tank at GKN Aerospace's Garden Grove plant prompted the evacuation of 50,000 residents, with a $125 million settlement contingent on court approval.

sources.title: Melrose shares climb on Garden Grove plant reopening timeline | MarketScreener
sources.quote: GKN Aerospace halted production in late May at a suburban Los Angeles plant after an overheating tank raised fears of an explosion and prompted the evacuation of 50,000 nearby residents for several days.

sources.title: Melrose's GKN Aerospace reaches $125m settlement for Garden Grove incident
sources.quote: The settlement comprises a claims programme of up to $100m for eligible residents and businesses, civil enforcement penalties of $15m and claims received to date by emergency services and relevant authorities of $10m.

sources.title: Melrose's GKN Aerospace reaches $125m settlement for Garden Grove incident
sources.quote: The settlement is contingent upon court approval and the claims programme is expected to open within days of court approval.

incidents.summary: A report stated that management immediately dismissed 422 workers at GKN's Campi Bisenzio plant by text message.

sources.title: GKN dispute in Florence – Italian workers are fighting back
sources.quote: On 9 July 2021, 422 workers at the Campi Bisenzio GKN plant near Florence received a text message.

sources.title: GKN dispute in Florence – Italian workers are fighting back
sources.quote: It came from the British multinational’s management, communicating that the workers were immediately and collectively dismissed.

sources.title: GKN dispute in Florence – Italian workers are fighting back
sources.quote: The answer is found in the fact that Melrose Industries PLC bought up GKN in 2018.
